notes: The main isnad (Qutayba, then Layth b. Saʿd and ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad together, then Yaḥyā, Saʿīd, Saʿd) carries the saying.
The opening remark «وقد روى غير، واحد» begins with an unnamed transmitter for the same saying: a variant (rule 4). «وهذا حديث حسن صحيح» is the compiler's verdict, not a chain.
